name: mindfulness knowledge domain query with follow-up
description: Tests the offline knowledge shelf mindfulness domain. The user asks about mindfulness practice, then about present-moment awareness, then transitions to a personal anxiety topic. Verifies that knowledge responses are returned from the mindfulness domain, that reply length exceeds 40 characters, and that natural conversational routing resumes after the knowledge query.

turns.text: How can I stay present in the moment?
My anxiety has been really bad lately

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: mindfulness keyword triggers knowledge rule, DaryaKnowledge.answer('en', 'mindfulness') returns 4 entries, reply length > 40 chars. Turn 2: 'present moment' hint maps to mindfulness domain, dialogueAct is 'question' due to question mark. Turn 3: 'anxiety' keyword triggers anxiety conversational rule (priority 40), engine returns empathetic response from anxiety pool.
expected.behavior: Knowledge rule (priority 55) matches on 'mindfulness' and 'present moment' keywords. Domain detection maps to 'mindfulness' via domainHints. Knowledge responses are returned as independent copies (.slice()). After knowledge, topic routing continues normally via the anxiety rule.
